---
title: "Quality of life — primary diagnostics"
subtitle: "Convergence across fifty completed datasets"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

The primary analysis stops unless every imputation satisfies the configured
R-hat and effective-sample-size thresholds after the permitted retry.

```{r}
#| label: summarize-primary-qol-diagnostics
#| echo: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
diagnostic_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "quality-of-life", "diagnostics"
)
diagnostics <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(config$imputation$main$m), function(index) {
  path <- file.path(diagnostic_dir, sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing QoL diagnostic artifact: ", path)
  out <- arrow::read_parquet(path) |>
    as.data.frame()
  out$imputation <- index
  out
}))

finite_rhat <- diagnostics$rhat[is.finite(diagnostics$rhat)]
finite_bulk <- diagnostics$ess_bulk[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_bulk)]
finite_tail <- diagnostics$ess_tail[is.finite(diagnostics$ess_tail)]
passed <- length(finite_rhat) > 0L && length(finite_bulk) > 0L &&
  length(finite_tail) > 0L &&
  all(finite_rhat <= config$diagnostics$max_rhat) &&
  all(finite_bulk >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk) &&
  all(finite_tail >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail)
if (!passed) stop("The pooled primary QoL diagnostic check failed.")

diagnostic_summary <- data.frame(
  models = config$imputation$main$m,
  maximum_rhat = max(finite_rhat),
  minimum_ess_bulk = min(finite_bulk),
  minimum_ess_tail = min(finite_tail),
  passed = passed
)
knitr::kable(diagnostic_summary)
```
